extracted.intended_audience: research mathematicians, prospective authors, librarians, and readers interested in Inventiones mathematicae
extracted.subtask_description: Metadata and high-level information about the journal Inventiones mathematicae including scope statement, journal-level metrics, indexing/abstracting services, article types, and publication metadata intended for readers and prospective authors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Journal scope / mission
rubrics_metrics.description: Since its inception in 1966, Inventiones mathematicae has been responsible for the publication of some of the most seminal results in a wide array of fields in the mathematical sciences. Led by an international editorial board of renowned experts, it continues to focus on the delivery of new contributions throughout all core areas of mathematics.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is the journal's self-described editorial scope: seminal/new contributions across core areas of mathematics; indicates the kinds of submissions the journal seeks (original, significant mathematical results).

rubrics_metrics.name: Journal Impact Factor
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Standard bibliometric indicator reported on the page; numeric value and year are shown to indicate citation-based impact for 2024.

rubrics_metrics.name: 5-year Journal Impact Factor
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Five-year citation-based impact metric; shown with numeric value and year to indicate longer-term citation performance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Downloads
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Aggregate download count displayed as a usage metric (number and year) for the journal's content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Latest issue / publication currency
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates the most recent published issue and volume/issue metadata, useful for understanding publication frequency and currency.

rubrics_metrics.name: Latest articles / article labels
rubrics_metrics.description: Latest articles list includes items such as 'OriginalPaper' and 'Open access' (e.g., On rationally integrable planar dual and projective billiards — OriginalPaper; Z/2 harmonic 1-forms... — OriginalPaper — Open access).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Shows article-type labels used by the journal (e.g., OriginalPaper) and open-access status; useful for authors to see typical article categories and OA availability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Open access article count
rubrics_metrics.description: This journal has 261 open access articles
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Count of open-access articles published in the journal, indicating extent of OA content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Abstracting and indexing
rubrics_metrics.description: Abstracted and indexed in ANVUR; BFI List; Baidu; CLOCKSS; CNKI; CNPIEC; Chinese Academy of Medical Science (CAMS); Current Contents/Physical, Chemical and Earth Sciences; Dimensions; EBSCO; Google Scholar; INIS Atomindex; INSPIRE; Japanese Science and Technology Agency (JST); Mathematical Reviews; Naver; OCLC WorldCat Discovery Service; Ovid Discovery; Portico; ProQuest; SCImago; SCOPUS; Science Citation Index Expanded (SCIE); TD Net Discovery Service; Wanfang; eLibrary.ru; zbMATH
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Comprehensive list of indexing and abstracting services that include the journal; signals discoverability and bibliographic coverage across databases.
